In NR FR2 TRx test specifications, the TT calculation under normal condition has been decided as a ratio of MTSU for many test cases. During last several meetings, some scenarios have been discussed where the MTSU might be enlarged, i.e. Extreme temperature, extending QZ to >30cm. It’s important to understand how TT will be impacted under these scenarios. This document provides some thought on this point.
